Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2722; unrestrainable:--unruly.
BiblicalUsage: Once, in James's chapter on the tongue: the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison. The word is unrestrainable — no bridle holds it, no cage contains it.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse about an unruly tongue carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is James's bluntness, that no man can tame it and it needs a Master no man can supply.
